premise.claim: Setting only spec.worker.runtimeVersion.imageTag (a legal edit per VersionSpec: image, imageTag and imagePullPolicy are independent optional strings) is silently ignored: updateImage returns early unless both halves are set, so the AdvancedStatefulSet keeps the old image with no error, event or condition, while the CacheRuntime's generation increments (issue #6178).
